kpis.name: Annual Congress Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the annual IVR Congress, representing member engagement and international reach across European inland navigation sector.
kpis.description: The number of participants at IVR's annual congress measures member engagement and organizational reach. In 2024, 225 participants from 11 different countries attended the congress in Frankfurt (May 15-17, 2024), reflecting stable and diversified participation.
kpis.signal: 225 participants from 11 countries at 2024 Congress in Frankfurt, demonstrating strong member engagement and international representation.

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participants
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium, representing engagement in technical knowledge-sharing and risk management initiatives.
kpis.description: Inaugural edition of IVR's Loss Prevention Colloquium held in Antwerp on November 4, 2024, bringing together 80 participants (insurers, brokers, maritime experts, lawyers and other stakeholders) around technical and financial topics relevant to European inland navigation.
kpis.signal: 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany at inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp (November 4, 2024), establishing new annual platform.

risks.title: Dependence on dominant market position in residential segment
risks.score_rationale: Major implicit risk: approximately 90% of revenue concentrated in residential 'Find' segment. Position described as 'unrivalled' but vulnerable to technological disruption or new entrants. Strategic language emphasizes diversification (Commercial, Data, Rental, Financial Services) signaling awareness of risk. Trend: stable but actively addressed.

risks.title: Risk of technological disruption and AI adoption by competitors
risks.score_rationale: Item 1A explicitly mentions AI as 'significant opportunity' but implicitly as competitive threat. Language: 'actively exploring and implementing' suggests defensive positioning. Ongoing cloud migration (half of services) indicates substantial investment. Trend: up (AI cited as 2024-2028 strategic priority).

risks.title: Dependence on UK residential real estate market health
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly addressed: 'economic uncertainty, driven by higher interest rates' in 2023. Transactions declined from 1.2M to 1.0M (-17%). Consumer traffic -4%, time on site -6%. Language: 'resilient' but data shows sensitivity. Trend: up (elevated mortgage rates persist).

risks.title: Risk of real estate market regulation and data protection
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in 'Risk management' (page 57) and 'transparent approach to ensuring compliance'. No specific details in Item 1A but Rightmove holds 'unparalleled and unique property market data' creating GDPR/data exposure. Language: moderate. Trend: stable (UK regulatory environment stable but Brexit creates uncertainty).

risks.title: Cybersecurity and operational resilience of platform
risks.score_rationale: Critical platform: 2.2 billion visits per year, sensitive data (properties, transactions, personal data). Cloud migration underway ('nearly half of all platform services') creates vulnerability window. Item 1A does not detail incidents or measures. Trend: up (cloud migration = temporarily elevated risk).

risks.title: Dependence on customer retention (real estate agents and agencies)
risks.score_rationale: Customer count declined from 19,014 to 18,785 (-1%). ARPA increased (+9%) offsetting but signals volume pressure. Language: 'deeper product partnerships' acknowledges retention need. Trend: stable but with underlying pressure.

risks.title: Risk of execution on new growth domains strategy
risks.score_rationale: 2024-2028 strategy ambitious: Commercial Real Estate, Data, Rental, Financial Services described as 'small' today. CEO change in March 2023 (Johan Svanstrom) adds execution risk. Language: 'significant opportunities' but no detailed success metrics. Trend: new (strategy formalized November 2023).

risks.title: Risk of talent and leadership continuity
risks.score_rationale: CEO change in March 2023 (Peter Brooks-Johnson to Johan Svanstrom after 16 years). Language: 'orderly and seamless transition' but recent transition. Kriti Sharma (AI expertise) appointed July 2023. Dependence on technical talent for AI/cloud initiatives. Trend: up (multiple transitions in 2023).

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents.
evidence: No references to AI, machine learning, APIs, or intelligent features
Focus is on traditional sectoral representation, standards development, and industry conferences
